question: Which assay/time/context coverage and RNA table semantics do the existing Daniel 2018/2020 source deposits actually support for the bounded E6 extension?
decision: Qualify an RNA-only source-average description if supported, while distinguishing assay-specific endpoint data, unqualified temporal joins and unrelated muscle sources.
strongest_rival: Combining different cell systems or assay-specific time labels into a false matched trajectory, double-counting superseries records, or reconstructing replicate variance from published group averages.
discriminator: Exact SOFT source membership and titles, deduplicated GSM inventory, all listed files, full normalized/raw RNA format arithmetic and exact source-column joins.
exposure_record: Original NAM N. brasiliensis-history/later-IAV context, published Daniel findings, metadata and table headers/first rows are exposed. No temporal-reference biological contrast has been computed.
biological_unit: Technical source records and table rows. Published group averages cannot recover replicate-level values, variance, effective n, sample pairing or animal independence.
nesting_and_overlap: Superseries and subseries repeat GSM records; report occurrences and deduplicated identities. Assay-specific time labels and repeated replicate names are not cross-assay joins.
population_and_selection: SOFT for GSE115505/GSE115085/GSE115504/GSE115502/GSE110465/GSE151015, GSE115504 memory averaged-CPM table, and GSE151015 raw RNA matrix. Audit every table row and column; no genotype contrast or biological selection.
contrast: Source/context/time-label coverage and table arithmetic only; no biological temporal estimate.
endpoint: Unique/overlapping GSM inventory, file listings, RNA column-to-source groups, average versus raw-count semantics, counts/zeros and explicit eligibility limits.
methods: Parse exact source fields with frozen E1 parser; do not convert hour tokens into a trajectory. Join memory columns to first/second-stimulation labels; inspect all group means. Audit raw RNA counts with explicit missing first-header handling. Verify whole-file totals by independent CSV/Python fsum/integer accounting.
missingness_and_exclusions: Retain every source record; superseries duplication is reported, not additional replication. Exclude unrelated muscle context from a prospective cultured-memory comparison. Do not invent per-replicate values, source durations, identities or missing peak counts.
multiplicity: No biological hypothesis tests or selected-locus comparisons. All structural checks retained.
precision_basis: Exact file/record accounting; no biological precision or power claim.
interpretation_limit: Metadata qualification supports only its stated subsequent descriptive possibilities; no matched RNA-ATAC time course, early-to-late RNA curve, causal persistence or NAM validation. No large archives, intervention ranking or infection response outputs.
stop_rule: Stop on input/code hash, parse, count-integrity or independent arithmetic conflict; retain failed receipts and partial evidence. Missing scientific identity/annotation details produce explicit holds, not invented repairs.
amendment_reason: Owner-authorized E6 bounded metadata qualification of existing temporal-reference leads; separate from the E1 2024 source and all historical runs.
